evidence.note: An empirical study of LLM verifiers on four subjective verification tasks from a production recommender platform, showing that explicit reasoning often degrades accuracy and that standard RLVR drives reasoning length to near zero ('reasoning collapse'), plus a conditional length-penalized reward that restores it.
evidence.title: LLM Reasoning for Subjective Tasks: Failure Modes, Mitigation, and Dynamic Reasoning Routing

name: Four internal Netflix verification tasks with human ground-truth labels (Conversational Query Sensitivity, Generated Text Response Sensitivity, Text: Response Quality, ID: Response Quality)
